senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be whole, complete; to end, cease.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:3:7">Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שלום שבימיו שָׁלְמָה וכ׳</he> Zedekiah was named Shallum, because in his days ended the reign of the house of Judah; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:1:10">Y. Shek. VI, 49ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:2:25">Y. Hor. III, 47ᶜ</cite> bot.; Bab.
<cite ref="Horayot 11b:3">Hor. 11ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Keritot 5b:65">Ker. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>ששלם</he> (corr. acc.); Yalk. Kings 250; Yalk. Chr. 1085.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 6:1">Pesik. R. s. 6</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 7:51">I Kings VII, 51</cite>) <he>כיון שבא … עכשיו שלמה מלאכת וכ׳</he> when Solomon came and built the Temple, the Lord said, now the work of heaven and earth (creation) is complete; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 186:1">Yalk. Kings 186</cite> <cite ref="U01327"><he>שְׁלֵימָה</he></cite>. Pesik. R. l. c. <he>כיון שהִשְׁלִימוּ … שלמה נפשם</he> when the workmen had finished their work, their life was finished (they died); Yalk. l. c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to complete, finish. Pesik. R. l. c., v. supra. Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵃ top; Y. Shebi. II, 34ᵃ top מכיון שהוא עומד … מַשְׁלִים שנתו since he stands in (has entered) the third year of the tree, he may count it a full year.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 33a:4">Yoma 33ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 6:5">Lev. VI, 5</cite>, play on <he>עליה … השלמים</he>) <he>עליה הַשְׁלֵם כל וכ׳</he> with it (the evening sacrifice) cease all sacrifices (none can be offered after it).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 10a:14">B. Kam. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>החופר … והִשְׁלִימָהּ לעשרה</he> if one digs a pit nine cubits deep, and another comes and completes it to the legal size of ten.
<cite ref="Berakhot 47b:16">Ber. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>שחרר … והִשְׁלִימוֹ וכ׳</he> he freed his slave and used him to complete the quorum of ten persons.

Ib. 8ᵇ המשלים פרשיותיו, v. פָּרָשָׁה I. Pesik. R. l. c. לכך נקרא שלמה שה׳ … לתוך מעשה ידיו he is called Sh’lomoh (perfect), because God caused the work of creation to be perfected through his handiwork (the Temple); Yalk. Kings l. c.; a. fr.—Esp. to finish the fast-day.
<cite ref="Taanit 7a:10">Taan. VII</cite>, 9 <he>יַשְׁלִימוּ</he> they must fast the whole day.

Yoma 82ᵃ מַשְׁלִימִין they must fast to the end of the day; a. fr.—Part. pass. מוּשְׁלָם perfect, virtuous. Hor. l. c. he was named Shallum שהיה מ׳ במעשיו Ag. Hatt. (ed. משולם) because he was perfect in his deeds; Yalk. Kings 250; Yalk. Chr. l. c.

senses.gloss: (denom. of שָׁלוֹם) to make friends, or to surrender.
units: Succ. 52ᵃ (ref. to Prov. XXV, 22) א״ת יְשַׁלֵּם אלא יַשְׁלִימֶנּוּ לך read not y’shallem (he will pay) but, he will surrender him (the evil spirit) to thee; (comment.; he will make him be friends with thee).—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7<sup>4</sup></cite> <he>אחד עשר יום היו מוּשְׁלָמִים לאלהים</he> eleven days were they (the Israelites) at peace with God (adhered to him sincerely); <he>כ״ט יום … מוּשְׁלָמִין</he> twenty-nine days they were sincere servants of God, opp. <he>עשו את העגל</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Ib.</cite> <he>אינם מושלמים לי וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>משלמים</he>, corr. acc.) they will be faithful to me only forty days.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. <he>מ׳ לבוראו</he> faithful to his Creator; a. e.
<cite ref="Exodus 19">Mishp. 19</cite> <he>המלאך אומר נ׳ פלוני</he> the angel says, such and such has ended (must die).

senses.gloss: to perfect.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּלָּם. Hor. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 458:3">Yalk. Lev. 458</cite> <he>מְשׁוּלָּמִים</he>, v. <cite ref="U01251"><he>שָׁלוֹם</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to compensate, reward, pay. Pesik. R. l. c. (play on ותשלם, I Kings VII, 51) עלי לשַׁלֵּם להם מתן שכר it is for me to pay them their reward.
units: <cite ref="I Kings 7:51">Ib.</cite> <he>עלי לשלם לו</he> it is for me to compensate it (the month of Kislev) for its loss; <he>ומה ש׳ לו וכ׳</he> and wherewith did he compensate it? With the dedication under the Hasmonean house. Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ top (ref. to <cite ref="Micah 7:3">Mic. VII, 3</cite>) <he>שַׁלֵּם לי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם לך</he> (the judge says,) pay me, and I shall pay thee (decide in thy favor).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:1">B. Kam. I, 1</cite> <he>חב המזיק לשלם וכ׳</he> he that caused the damage is bound to pay &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>משַׁלֵּם נזק שלם</he> must pay the full indemnity.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:1">B. Mets. III, 1</cite> <he>ש׳ ולא רצה וכ׳</he> if he pays in preference to making oath.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 3:4">B. Bath. III, 4</cite> <he>מְשַׁלְּמִין לו את הכל</he> they must pay him in full.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:16">Ab. II, 16</cite> <he>שׁיְשַׁלֵּם</he>, v. <cite ref="U01184"><he>שָׂכָר</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
